project.description: littlejlib-jr - jr, a Java/TeaVM launcher that picks java.exe/javaw.exe (or posix_spawn's java on Linux/macOS), reads a sibling .jrc config, manages an AOT cache, and auto-installs a matching JDK on Windows. Supersedes jr_legacy_c, the original C implementation, as the primary implementation - see this repo's CLAUDE.md for the platform decision.
